_doc: STAGING. Ruled SHIP by the combined board as the highest-yielding new candidate, with constraints that are not optional and are the reason it was allowed at all. The store is a Black women's institution regardless of who holds the deed, and the seats who own this material ruled that erasing it to avoid discomfort is the bigger dignity failure. So: THE CUSTOMER IS ALWAYS THE SUBJECT. Never the counter, never an accent, never a transaction-tension gag. The `owner` row from the candidate draft is cut, and no clue here references the proprietor's ethnicity, English, or surveillance — the store is the aisle, the bundle, the bonnet, and the girl choosing. Wing 7 (women's interiority) holds a veto on this clue set and reads every line before ship.

theme.name: The Beauty Supply
theme.blurb: Aisle four, forty shades of the same thing, and a decision that takes twenty minutes.

boards.scene: Aisle four, and the twenty minutes it takes

clues.pointe: The precision this takes, and nobody who has not done it believes you
clues.point: At the one on the top shelf, because it is always on the top shelf
clues.tone: Held against the back of your hand under a light that lies to you
clues.open: One pack, carefully, to check — and put back exactly as it was
clues.pin: In the bag of six, and you will need every one of them tonight
clues.note: In your phone from last time, with the number, so this goes faster

boards.scene: The shelf where everything is a cream

clues.calmer: How you feel once the right jar is in your hand and the search is over
clues.cream: In the tub with the wide lid, and the smell decides it before the label does
clues.lace: The front, sold by the inch, and the good ones are behind the counter
clues.real: The word doing the most work on that entire wall of packaging
clues.care: What the aisle is actually for, and the word is right there on half the tubs
clues.clam: How tight the lid is, and why she asks somebody to start it for her

boards.scene: Edge control, and the small brush

clues.legacy: What your edges are: your mother's, and hers, and the same brush
clues.gel: The little tub, and everybody has a position on which one is correct
clues.lace: Laid with the brush, then wrapped, then left alone for ten minutes
clues.lay: The whole verb. It carries the edges, the wig and the entire afternoon
clues.clay: What the cheap one turns into by hour four, and why it is the cheap one
clues.gale: What the wrap protects against, on the walk to the car in November

boards.scene: The cap, and what goes over it

clues.chapel: Where the finished result is going on Sunday, which sets the whole budget
clues.cap: The base everything else is built on, and the wrong size ruins all of it
clues.lace: Cut to the hairline with the small scissors, and there is no second try
clues.cheap: The trap on the bottom shelf, bought once by everyone, exactly once
clues.pale: The shade the photo on the packet is, and the shade it is not
clues.peach: The clip colour, and there are nine of them in the bag for a reason

boards.scene: What she says when you ask her opinion

clues.preach: What the woman in the next aisle does when you ask, and she is right
clues.cheap: The word she uses about the one you are holding, with real feeling
clues.reach: Past you, without asking, to hand you the one you should have
clues.cap: What she takes off the shelf instead, one size up from the one you had
clues.care: What the whole exchange is, from a stranger, in under a minute
clues.pace: Hers, through the aisle, of somebody who has done this a hundred times

boards.scene: Colour, and the decision under bad light

clues.argyle: The pattern on the only chair in the shop, and it has been there for years
clues.gel: Beside it, because the two purchases go together whether you planned it
clues.real: What you are checking for, holding a strand up, in the doorway light
clues.gray: The reason for the box, said out loud by nobody, ever
clues.year: How long since the last big change, and this is how it starts
clues.rely: On the one brand that has never once let you down, at any price

boards.scene: Paying, and what is in the bag

clues.chairs: Two, by the door, for the people who came with somebody
clues.cash: Counted out, because the card machine has an opinion about small totals
clues.hair: Four packs of it, and the fourth was bought because three is never enough
clues.rich: How the good bundle feels between two fingers, and you know instantly
clues.arch: Of the brow in the mirror by the till, checking one last time
clues.airs: What nobody in this shop puts on, and the reason people come here

clues.picker: Nobody's word for it. Everybody's word for the person who is fussy
clues.pick: Metal or plastic, and the fist on the handle is not decorative
clues.price: In marker on the shelf edge, and it has been the same for six years
clues.epic: The wall itself: nine feet of combs, and you need exactly one
clues.ripe: What the timing has to be, on a wash day planned around a Saturday
clues.ice: In the cup by the till, mostly melted, since about eleven

boards.scene: Saturday morning, before the shop fills

clues.carpet: The strip by the door, worn through in one place by one direction of traffic
clues.cap: First thing in the basket, because you already know that part
clues.part: What the whole plan starts from, decided in the mirror at home
clues.trace: Of last night's gel still at the hairline, and it is coming out today
clues.crate: By the register, holding the ones that came in on Thursday
clues.pace: Yours at nine in the morning, which is why you came at nine

boards.scene: The walk back to the car

clues.bagels: From two doors down, because the aisle took longer than anybody planned
clues.bag: Thin, doubled at the till, and it will not survive the parking lot
clues.gel: In it, on its side, and this is how the lid ends up loose
clues.sale: The sign in that window since before you moved onto this block
clues.able: What you are, to do all of this yourself, which was never in doubt
clues.gale: What the wind does on that corner to a thin doubled bag, every time

boards.scene: The relaxer box, and the timer

clues.tamper: What you do not do with the timing, not by one minute, ever
clues.perm: In the box with the two bottles, and the instructions are not a suggestion
clues.part: Into four, greased at the scalp, before a single thing is opened
clues.team: Two people, because doing your own back is how it goes wrong
clues.tape: On the mirror, with the timing written on it in marker
clues.mart: The one on the corner, open until nine, which is why tonight is possible

boards.scene: The wait, and who is ahead of you

clues.wraith: How you feel by minute forty, still holding two packs
clues.hair: Everybody in here is holding some, and no two are buying the same thing
clues.wait: Not for a till. For the woman at the counter to finish her opinion
clues.hart: On the calendar behind the register, from a garage, from 2011
clues.wrath: Of the person behind you, entirely silent, entirely legible
clues.with: Who you came, and whether they are helping or are on their phone
